package.title: Messenger UX pack: new-chat ordering, header avatar + rename, member '@'-search, stack redeploy, mark-all-read

specification.intent: Six operator items in one contour: (1) freshly created chats sort to the TOP of the list (activityOrder falls back to created_at); (2) chat-avatar editing moves from the list card to the messenger header (left of the title, owner-only affordance, never offered in an archived chat) and long titles stop overflowing; (3) double-click inline rename saving on Enter/Escape/outside click, allowed to any ACTIVE member (never offered in an archived chat), persisting a who-and-when system message (messages.kind, migration 012) and broadcasting chat_renamed; (4) «Найти все чаты» enabled in the contacts menu seeding '@'+login into the chat search and listing every shared chat — the same '@'-branch serves manual typing in the search bar (member login/display_name prefix match); (5) kick/leave restored by rebuilding the stale compose API container (repo code already consistent — verified 401-vs-404 probes); (6) the list-header settings icon becomes «Пометить всё прочитанными» (POST /chats/read-all), active only when unread exists.

requirements.title: PUT /chats/{id}: active-member rename + persistent system message + chat_renamed broadcast
requirements.description: ChatUpdate {title 1..200}; PUT /api/v1/chats/{chat_id} behind get_current_user, require_active_member guard (archived 403, unknown 404, anonymous 401). The method is PUT — the repo precedent for partial-update semantics without a PATCH verb (PUT /auth/profile, src/features/profile/api/own.ts; HTTPTransport has no patch method). Service rename(): strip title; identical title → idempotent 200 no-op WITHOUT a message; otherwise update Chat.title and insert Message(user_id=caller, content=f"{actor display_name} переименовал чат в «{new title}»", kind='chat_renamed') in ONE transaction; after commit broadcast to ACTIVE members (a) {'type':'message','content':MessageResponse-with-kind} and (b) {'type':'chat_renamed','content':{'chat_id','title'}} (hub.broadcast active_user_ids — the delete_chat precedent). messages.kind nullable String(16) via migration 012; MessageResponse gains additive kind: str|None = None (present fills it via model_validate). Response: updated ChatResponse.
requirements.source: operator request 2026-11-05 item 3 + clarification (any active member; system message with actor and time; WS broadcast approved)

requirements.title: POST /chats/read-all: bulk read-marker upsert
requirements.description: POST /api/v1/chats/read-all behind get_current_user; ChatReadAllResponse {updated: int}. Repository mark_all_read(user_id): one dialect-aware INSERT..SELECT (pg/sqlite like mark_read) — for every membership of the caller INCLUDING archived (matching unread_counts semantics) upsert chat_last_reads.last_read_message_id = max(messages.id) per chat, ON CONFLICT (user_id, chat_id) DO UPDATE only forward (existing < new); chats without messages produce no row; 'updated' = chats covered by the SELECT. No WS fan-out (read state is per-user).

requirements.title: GET /chats/search '@' branch: chats by member login/display_name prefix
requirements.description: q starting with '@': term = q[1:] stripped; empty term → 200 results: []. Repository search_member_matches(user_id, term): chats with ANY membership of the caller where ANOTHER member (user_id != caller) matches case-insensitive PREFIX on lower(email) OR lower(coalesce(display_name,'')) with escape_like; per chat the deterministic first match (min user_id) yields the snippet name (display_name or login). Service: matched_in='member' (Literal extended), snippet {before:'', match:<name>, after:''}, last_match_at=None; ordering by chat activity (last_message.created_at ?? chat.created_at, id DESC), cap CHATS_SEARCH_RESULTS_CAP. Non-'@' queries byte-identical to today.
requirements.source: operator request 2026-11-05 item 4 + clarification ('@'+full email seed)

requirements.title: Chat list ordering, header avatar slot, long-title overflow fix
requirements.description: ChatInfo.created_at?: string (utils/types.ts); own adapter toChatInfo maps it; activityOrder falls back to Date.parse(created_at) when last_message is absent/invalid (NaN → -Infinity), tie id DESC. chatListUser: InputFile/onChatFile/avatar onClick/pencil background and hover affordances REMOVED (template + scss); chat.hbs stops passing onChatFile. Messenger header: chat avatar block left of the title (the 77px slot; desktop padding reduced, mobile keeps the back-button row), hidden InputFile + onChatAvatar wiring (existing changeChatAvatar path), pencil+click affordance ONLY when meId === ownerId AND the chat is NOT archived (the same leftAt flag that hides the composer and the cross button — an archived owner must not get a 403 path); title gets flex:1 + min-width:0 so long names ellipsize.

requirements.title: Inline rename UI, system-message rendering, chat_renamed WS handling
requirements.description: messenger.hbs: while renamingTitle the title swaps to <input> (root-delegated dblclick; Enter/Escape keydown and focusout commit); empty trimmed value silently reverts; commit → onRenameChat(chatId, title). The dblclick→input affordance is gated by the archived flag (chatInfo.leftAt — the same flag that hides the composer and the cross button): an archived member never gets the input. Controller renameChat(): optimistic chats-slice title patch, port.renameChat (PUT + csrf header), error → revert + console.error. message-mapping.ts toMessage + OwnMessageResponse pass kind; Message.kind?: string; mapTypedMessages → isSystem (kind != null); message.hbs renders system entries as a centered muted service line with time (no bubble/avatar/reply). WS: own adapter handles 'chat_renamed' → gateway notifyChatRenamed → controller patches the slice title (skip identical); 'message' events with kind flow through the existing append path.
requirements.source: operator request 2026-11-05 item 3 (dblclick, save without confirmation on Enter/Esc/outside — Esc SAVES per clarification)

requirements.title: «Пометить всё прочитанными» on the list-header icon
requirements.description: public/images/mark-all-read-icon.svg (double-check, currentColor); HeaderIcons second icon switches from settings-icon.svg (alt/naming updated — no longer settings), onClick → controller markAllRead(); page mapper passes hasUnread = chats.some(unread_count > 0); icon dimmed + pointer-events:none without unread (chat.scss modifier). markAllRead(): port.readAll() → POST /chats/read-all + csrf → store patch unread_count=0 across chats. /settings via BottomBar unchanged.

requirements.title: «Найти все чаты» + '@'-search frontend wiring
requirements.description: ChatSearchMatch.matched_in gains 'member' (utils/types.ts + own DTO literal — added by WS-FE-CHAT in shared files); searchOrder renders member matches via the existing snippet path (pinned by test, not changed). Contacts menu «Найти все чаты» enabled (disabled/title removed); click → ContactsController.findChats(id) resolves login from the slice and calls injected chatSearchOpener(login); error → menu feedback «Не удалось выполнить поиск». Consumer-side seam setChatSearchOpener (default noop) in the contacts controller; features/index.ts wires: setChatSearchBarValue('@'+login); void ChatsController.searchChats('@'+login); Router.go(MESSENGER). searchBar.ts exports setChatSearchBarValue(value) writing module memory (lastTypedValue, wasFocused:false) and clearing the pending debounce timer.

requirements.title: Compose stack rebuild restoring kick/leave and shipping the new routes
requirements.description: Operator-approved runbook procedure (docs/deployment/own-backend.md): a committed probe script scripts/probe-own-backend-routes.ps1 (health curls + unauthenticated 401-vs-404 route table for DELETE /chats/{id}/members/{uid}, POST /chats/{id}/leave, POST /chats/{id}/rejoin, PUT /chats/{id}, POST /chats/read-all, GET /chats/search?q=@a); docker compose --env-file <operator env> config --quiet; up -d --build; authenticated smoke against the seeded admin (rename → system message + title, '@'-search, read-all zeroing, kick + leave on a scratch chat); alembic heads == 012. Rollback per runbook on health failure. The only repository write is the probe script itself.
requirements.source: operator request 2026-11-05 item 5 + clarification (rebuild approved); root cause verified: live container built 2026-11-01 12:13 pre-chat-leave, routes 404 while repo code is consistent

specification.goal: The messenger list and header behave like a polished product: fresh chats on top, avatar and title managed in place (owner-only avatar, dblclick rename with an auditable system trail), '@'-search answering «all chats with this user», working kick/leave again, and a one-click mark-all-read.
constraints: Layers only downward (pages -> components -> controllers -> api -> utils -> core); guard-architecture --all --strict stays green; components never import features/controllers; UI types never import from api/; features never import each other — the only NEW cross-feature seam is setChatSearchOpener wired in src/features/index.ts.
Migration 012 is additive (messages.kind nullable); alembic heads becomes 012_message_kind; segment tests 009/010/011 stay green (repin owned by WS-BE-API only if an isolation assertion breaks).
All new endpoints behind get_current_user; anonymous 401 pinned; mutating frontend calls carry readCsrfToken().
AppState (utils/Store.ts) is NOT edited — new state rides existing slices and the in-slice cast idiom.

Existing suites stay green; counts grow from the recorded base (mocha 655 passing; pytest 277 passed + 4 known Windows ingestion failures documented as environment deviations with full logs retained).
System message content is server-built but renders through the Message double-brace path (XSS pin); '@'-snippets flow through the existing escape-then-wrap builder.
The chat-list card loses its avatar-edit affordance entirely (no hidden input, no pencil, no click) — the affordance lives ONLY in the messenger header, gated to the owner.
nonGoals: per-user local chat titles (title stays shared)
rename history beyond the persisted system messages
server-side suppression of reactions/replies to system messages — the backend does not block them; the service line simply exposes no affordances in the UI
search index migration for lower(email)/lower(display_name) (study-scale prefix scan)
read-state WS fan-out to other members
a replacement settings surface — the list-header icon changes purpose; /settings via BottomBar is unchanged
changing chat-creation dedup semantics — multiple chats per user are already allowed (POST /chats always creates; the contacts «Создать» DM get-or-create stays as-is)
specification.scope: backend (PUT /chats/{id} + messages.kind migration 012 + system message + chat_renamed broadcast; POST /chats/read-all; '@'-branch of GET /chats/search; pytest incl. segment coverage); ops (compose rebuild + probes; the only repo write is scripts/probe-own-backend-routes.ps1); frontend chats feature (ordering, header avatar, overflow fix, rename UI, system-message rendering, chat_renamed handling, mark-all-read icon, controller/port/adapter methods); frontend contacts/search seam (enabled button, opener seam, searchBar seeding, features/index wiring); docs (progress_log, NEXT.md); receipts under work/2026-11-05-messenger-ux-pack/.
